name: delivery
title: Delivery Project
description: Plan work, record decisions and track delivery.
instructions: Keep plans, decisions and delivery updates in the project's channels. Ask for approval before external actions.

skills.name: status-review
skills.instructions: Summarize completed work, current blockers, decisions needed and next steps. State missing evidence explicitly.

name: initiative
title: Initiative
description: Coordinate a group of projects with confined rollups.
instructions: Coordinate child projects and summarize their visible status, risks and decisions. Do not execute work directly inside a child project. Cross-project execution requires an explicitly supported and authorized handoff.

name: account
title: Customer Account
description: Keep customer context, plans and renewal work together.
instructions: Keep customer information inside this account. Separate confirmed facts from proposals and require approval before communicating externally.
